title: 比利時斯特勒比—蒂厄升船機
subcategoryTitleEn: Tidal barriers, navigation and dam construction
summary: 本課以比利時斯特勒比—蒂厄升船機為入口，深入纜索承載、雙船廂獨立性與高架航道銜接。十個單元各自對應不同的荷載路徑、能量交換或監測問題，從守恆式建立量化估算，再檢查量測配置是否能辨認真正失效原因。工程史實只採用列明範圍的公開一手資料；所有模型輸入另標為教學假設，成果是可追溯的工程判讀紀錄。
summaryEn: Using Strepy-Thieu boat lift as its entry point, this course examines cable load sharing, independent caissons and elevated-reach interfaces. Ten units address different load paths, energy exchanges or monitoring questions, starting with conservation-based estimates and testing whether observations distinguish failure causes. Historical statements use scoped primary evidence. Numerical model inputs are separately identified as teaching assumptions, producing a traceable engineering interpretation record.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「船廂水位與額外質量」與「纜索群載重分配」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Caisson level and extra mass" and "Cable-group load sharing": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 船廂水位與額外質量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Caisson level and extra mass: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「船廂水位與額外質量」如何影響比利時斯特勒比—蒂厄升船機的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Caisson level and extra mass” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Strepy-Thieu boat lift”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 浮船排水只在船廂水位固定時保持總質量，水位偏差則直接增加或減少水量。大平面船廂即使小幅水位變化，也會使配重平衡出現明顯差異。 取淡水密度ρ=1000 kg/m³。假設船廂有效面積1200 m²、水位偏高0.03 m，額外淡水質量ρAΔh=36000 kg=36 t；忽略船體水線面排除面積。 若船舶長時間遮蔽部分水面，沿用全空廂面積會高估增量。水位計基準偏差又會使每次循環都出現同方向失配，不能誤判為索具永久伸長。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「船廂水位與額外質量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Vessel displacement preserves total mass only at a fixed caisson level. A level error directly changes water volume, so even a small change across a large plan area noticeably alters counterweight balance. Use freshwater density ρ=1000 kg/m³. Assume effective caisson area 1200 m² and excess level 0.03 m. Added freshwater mass ρAΔh=36000 kg=36 t, neglecting the vessel waterplane exclusion. Using empty-caisson area while a vessel occupies the surface overstates the increment. Gauge datum bias creates same-direction mismatch each cycle and must not be mistaken for permanent rope extension. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Caisson level and extra mass” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取淡水密度ρ=1000 kg/m³。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use freshwater density ρ=1000 kg/m³.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「浮船船廂總重在任何水位變化下都完全不變。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A floating-vessel caisson keeps identical total mass despite any water-level change." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「船廂水位與額外質量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Caisson level and extra mass”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 船廂水位與額外質量
knowledge.text: 浮船排水只在船廂水位固定時保持總質量，水位偏差則直接增加或減少水量。大平面船廂即使小幅水位變化，也會使配重平衡出現明顯差異。
knowledge.textEn: Vessel displacement preserves total mass only at a fixed caisson level. A level error directly changes water volume, so even a small change across a large plan area noticeably alters counterweight balance.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：浮船船廂總重在任何水位變化下都完全不變。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A floating-vessel caisson keeps identical total mass despite any water-level change. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「比利時斯特勒比—蒂厄升船機」的「船廂水位與額外質量：機制與系統路徑」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出流域、入流、儲存、出流與下游的水量邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「水庫數據調度桌」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與同時間窗的流量、水位、截面與儀器校正紀錄的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Caisson level and extra mass: mechanism and system paths” in “Strepy-Thieu boat lift”. Draw the catchment, inflow, storage, outflow and downstream water balance; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Reservoir data planning desk” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for flow, level, section and calibration records for the same time window, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 關於「船廂水位與額外質量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Caisson level and extra mass" is correct?
options: 浮船船廂總重在任何水位變化下都完全不變。
浮船排水只在船廂水位固定時保持總質量，水位偏差則直接增加或減少水量。
總重量除索數就能代表任何一條索的實際最大張力。
optionsEn: A floating-vessel caisson keeps identical total mass despite any water-level change.
Vessel displacement preserves total mass only at a fixed caisson level.
Total weight divided by rope count gives every ropes actual maximum tension.
quiz.explanation: 浮船排水只在船廂水位固定時保持總質量，水位偏差則直接增加或減少水量。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Vessel displacement preserves total mass only at a fixed caisson level. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 船廂水位與額外質量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Caisson level and extra mass: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「船廂水位與額外質量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Caisson level and extra mass” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取淡水密度ρ=1000 kg/m³。假設船廂有效面積1200 m²、水位偏高0.03 m，額外淡水質量ρAΔh=36000 kg=36 t；忽略船體水線面排除面積。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use freshwater density ρ=1000 kg/m³. Assume effective caisson area 1200 m² and excess level 0.03 m. Added freshwater mass ρAΔh=36000 kg=36 t, neglecting the vessel waterplane exclusion. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較入廂前後多點水位並平均波動，核對面積是否已扣除船體水線面；另以索力總和反算質量，檢查水位推估和力學量測是否一致。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Average multiple level readings around entry, checking whether vessel waterplane area is excluded.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取淡水密度ρ=1000 kg/m³。假設船廂有效面積1200 m²、水位偏高0.03 m，額外淡水質量ρAΔh=36000 kg=36 t；忽略船體水線面排除面積。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use freshwater density ρ=1000 kg/m³. Assume effective caisson area 1200 m² and excess level 0.03 m. Added freshwater mass ρAΔh=36000 kg=36 t, neglecting the vessel waterplane exclusion.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「船廂水位與額外質量」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Caisson level and extra mass", which statement holds?
options: 索輪直徑比足夠大就能保證鋼索不會發生疲勞。
塔頂偏移只能由塔柱本身彎曲造成，基礎不會影響。
教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取淡水密度ρ=1000 kg/m³。
optionsEn: A sufficiently large sheave-diameter ratio guarantees that ropes cannot fatigue.
Top displacement can only come from tower bending and is unaffected by foundations.
Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use freshwater density ρ=1000 kg/m³.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取淡水密度ρ=1000 kg/m³。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use freshwater density ρ=1000 kg/m³. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 船廂水位與額外質量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Caisson level and extra mass: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「船廂水位與額外質量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Caisson level and extra mass” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較入廂前後多點水位並平均波動，核對面積是否已扣除船體水線面；另以索力總和反算質量，檢查水位推估和力學量測是否一致。另外檢查船舶進出時水位計受到遮蔽的區段。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Average multiple level readings around entry, checking whether vessel waterplane area is excluded. Independently infer mass from summed tensions and compare the level-based and force-based estimates. Also identify intervals when vessel entry or exit obstructs the level measurement. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以船廂水位與額外質量編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。比較入廂前後多點水位並平均波動，核對面積是否已扣除船體水線面；另以索力總和反算質量，檢查水位推估和力學量測是否一致。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for caisson level and extra mass, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Average multiple level readings around entry, checking whether vessel waterplane area is excluded. Independently infer mass from summed tensions and compare the level-based and force-based estimates.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若船舶長時間遮蔽部分水面，沿用全空廂面積會高估增量。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using empty-caisson area while a vessel occupies the surface overstates the increment. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 比較入廂前後多點水位並平均波動，核對面積是否已扣除船體水線面；另以索力總和反算質量，檢查水位推估和力學量測是否一致。另外檢查船舶進出時水位計受到遮蔽的區段。
knowledge.textEn: Average multiple level readings around entry, checking whether vessel waterplane area is excluded. Independently infer mass from summed tensions and compare the level-based and force-based estimates. Also identify intervals when vessel entry or exit obstructs the level measurement.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以船廂水位與額外質量編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。比較入廂前後多點水位並平均波動，核對面積是否已扣除船體水線面；另以索力總和反算質量，檢查水位推估和力學量測是否一致。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for caisson level and extra mass, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Average multiple level readings around entry, checking whether vessel waterplane area is excluded. Independently infer mass from summed tensions and compare the level-based and force-based estimates.

quiz.question: 要驗證「船廂水位與額外質量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Caisson level and extra mass"?
options: 比較入廂前後多點水位並平均波動，核對面積是否已扣除船體水線面；另以索力總和反算質量，檢查水位推估和力學量測是否一致。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
配重平衡後，制動器就不需要吸收系統的動能。
optionsEn: Average multiple level readings around entry, checking whether vessel waterplane area is excluded.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Once counterweights balance gravity the brakes need absorb no kinetic energy.
quiz.explanation: 比較入廂前後多點水位並平均波動，核對面積是否已扣除船體水線面；另以索力總和反算質量，檢查水位推估和力學量測是否一致。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Average multiple level readings around entry, checking whether vessel waterplane area is excluded. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 船廂水位與額外質量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Caisson level and extra mass: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「船廂水位與額外質量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Caisson level and extra mass” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若船舶長時間遮蔽部分水面，沿用全空廂面積會高估增量。水位計基準偏差又會使每次循環都出現同方向失配，不能誤判為索具永久伸長。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using empty-caisson area while a vessel occupies the surface overstates the increment. Gauge datum bias creates same-direction mismatch each cycle and must not be mistaken for permanent rope extension. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：水位計基準偏差又會使每次循環都出現同方向失配，不能誤判為索具永久伸長。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Gauge datum bias creates same-direction mismatch each cycle and must not be mistaken for permanent rope extension.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「浮船船廂總重在任何水位變化下都完全不變。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A floating-vessel caisson keeps identical total mass despite any water-level change." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若船舶長時間遮蔽部分水面，沿用全空廂面積會高估增量。水位計基準偏差又會使每次循環都出現同方向失配，不能誤判為索具永久伸長。
knowledge.textEn: Using empty-caisson area while a vessel occupies the surface overstates the increment. Gauge datum bias creates same-direction mismatch each cycle and must not be mistaken for permanent rope extension.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「船廂水位與額外質量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Caisson level and extra mass" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若船舶長時間遮蔽部分水面，沿用全空廂面積會高估增量。
總重量除索數就能代表任何一條索的實際最大張力。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Using empty-caisson area while a vessel occupies the surface overstates the increment.
Total weight divided by rope count gives every ropes actual maximum tension.
quiz.explanation: 若船舶長時間遮蔽部分水面，沿用全空廂面積會高估增量。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using empty-caisson area while a vessel occupies the surface overstates the increment. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 纜索群載重分配：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Cable-group load sharing: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「纜索群載重分配」如何影響比利時斯特勒比—蒂厄升船機的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Cable-group load sharing” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Strepy-Thieu boat lift”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 多條懸吊索讓總荷載分散，但單索張力取決於長度、剛度與均衡裝置。總索數除重量只提供理想平均，不保證最大索力或端部連接需求。 假設懸吊合力64 MN、80條索理想均分，每索0.8 MN；若一組10條承擔總力20%，該組每索1.28 MN。 索力平均值正常仍可能藏有少數高載索，替換索的剛度差亦會重新分配荷載。若只抽測外側容易接近的索，會忽略內部群組的系統性偏差。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「纜索群載重分配」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Many suspension ropes distribute total load, but individual tension depends on length, stiffness and equalization. Dividing weight by rope count gives an ideal mean rather than the maximum tension or anchorage demand. Assume suspension resultant 64 MN shared ideally by eighty ropes, giving 0.8 MN each. If ten ropes carry twenty percent of total force, each in that group carries 1.28 MN. A normal mean can conceal a few overloaded ropes, and replacement-rope stiffness changes sharing. Sampling only easily reached outer ropes can miss a systematic imbalance in internal groups. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Cable-group load sharing” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設懸吊合力64 MN、80條索理想均分，每索0.8 MN；若一組10條承擔總力20%，該組每索1.28 MN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume suspension resultant 64 MN shared ideally by eighty ropes, giving 0.8 MN each.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「總重量除索數就能代表任何一條索的實際最大張力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Total weight divided by rope count gives every ropes actual maximum tension." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「纜索群載重分配」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Cable-group load sharing”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 纜索群載重分配
knowledge.text: 多條懸吊索讓總荷載分散，但單索張力取決於長度、剛度與均衡裝置。總索數除重量只提供理想平均，不保證最大索力或端部連接需求。
knowledge.textEn: Many suspension ropes distribute total load, but individual tension depends on length, stiffness and equalization. Dividing weight by rope count gives an ideal mean rather than the maximum tension or anchorage demand.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：總重量除索數就能代表任何一條索的實際最大張力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Total weight divided by rope count gives every ropes actual maximum tension. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「纜索群載重分配」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Cable-group load sharing" is correct?
options: 總重量除索數就能代表任何一條索的實際最大張力。
均衡梁存在就表示兩端張力必定完全相等。
多條懸吊索讓總荷載分散，但單索張力取決於長度、剛度與均衡裝置。
optionsEn: Total weight divided by rope count gives every ropes actual maximum tension.
The presence of an equalizer means both end tensions are always equal.
Many suspension ropes distribute total load, but individual tension depends on length, stiffness and equalization.
quiz.explanation: 多條懸吊索讓總荷載分散，但單索張力取決於長度、剛度與均衡裝置。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Many suspension ropes distribute total load, but individual tension depends on length, stiffness and equalization. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 纜索群載重分配：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Cable-group load sharing: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「纜索群載重分配」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Cable-group load sharing” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設懸吊合力64 MN、80條索理想均分，每索0.8 MN；若一組10條承擔總力20%，該組每索1.28 MN。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume suspension resultant 64 MN shared ideally by eighty ropes, giving 0.8 MN each. If ten ropes carry twenty percent of total force, each in that group carries 1.28 MN. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：建立全部索力分布並比較同組與跨組差異，用總和核對懸吊平衡；將長度校準、端接移動和均衡梁位置一起記錄，查異常能否重複。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Map all tensions within and between groups and check their sum against suspended load.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設懸吊合力64 MN、80條索理想均分，每索0.8 MN；若一組10條承擔總力20%，該組每索1.28 MN。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume suspension resultant 64 MN shared ideally by eighty ropes, giving 0.8 MN each. If ten ropes carry twenty percent of total force, each in that group carries 1.28 MN.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「纜索群載重分配」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Cable-group load sharing", which statement holds?
options: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設懸吊合力64 MN、80條索理想均分，每索0.8 MN；若一組10條承擔總力20%，該組每索1.28 MN。
減速比增加會在保持轉矩不變下額外創造機械功率。
任何船廂與配重系統的移動距離都一定相同。
optionsEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume suspension resultant 64 MN shared ideally by eighty ropes, giving 0.8 MN each.
Increasing gear reduction creates additional mechanical power without changing torque demand.
Every caisson-counterweight arrangement necessarily has equal travel distances.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設懸吊合力64 MN、80條索理想均分，每索0.8 MN；若一組10條承擔總力20%，該組每索1.28 MN。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume suspension resultant 64 MN shared ideally by eighty ropes, giving 0.8 MN each. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 纜索群載重分配：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Cable-group load sharing: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「纜索群載重分配」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Cable-group load sharing” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 建立全部索力分布並比較同組與跨組差異，用總和核對懸吊平衡；將長度校準、端接移動和均衡梁位置一起記錄，查異常能否重複。以最大值和分位數呈現分配，而非只有平均值。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Map all tensions within and between groups and check their sum against suspended load. Record length calibration, anchorage movement and equalizer position, testing whether anomalies repeat under matched conditions. Report maxima and distribution quantiles instead of presenting only the mean tension. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以纜索群載重分配編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。建立全部索力分布並比較同組與跨組差異，用總和核對懸吊平衡；將長度校準、端接移動和均衡梁位置一起記錄，查異常能否重複。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for cable-group load sharing, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Map all tensions within and between groups and check their sum against suspended load. Record length calibration, anchorage movement and equalizer position, testing whether anomalies repeat under matched conditions.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：索力平均值正常仍可能藏有少數高載索，替換索的剛度差亦會重新分配荷載。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A normal mean can conceal a few overloaded ropes, and replacement-rope stiffness changes sharing. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 建立全部索力分布並比較同組與跨組差異，用總和核對懸吊平衡；將長度校準、端接移動和均衡梁位置一起記錄，查異常能否重複。以最大值和分位數呈現分配，而非只有平均值。
knowledge.textEn: Map all tensions within and between groups and check their sum against suspended load. Record length calibration, anchorage movement and equalizer position, testing whether anomalies repeat under matched conditions. Report maxima and distribution quantiles instead of presenting only the mean tension.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以纜索群載重分配編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。建立全部索力分布並比較同組與跨組差異，用總和核對懸吊平衡；將長度校準、端接移動和均衡梁位置一起記錄，查異常能否重複。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for cable-group load sharing, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Map all tensions within and between groups and check their sum against suspended load. Record length calibration, anchorage movement and equalizer position, testing whether anomalies repeat under matched conditions.

quiz.question: 要驗證「纜索群載重分配」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Cable-group load sharing"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
建立全部索力分布並比較同組與跨組差異，用總和核對懸吊平衡；將長度校準、端接移動和均衡梁位置一起記錄，查異常能否重複。
對接時量到的全部進水量都一定是止水失效漏流。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Map all tensions within and between groups and check their sum against suspended load.
All water measured during docking must be leakage caused by seal failure.
quiz.explanation: 建立全部索力分布並比較同組與跨組差異，用總和核對懸吊平衡；將長度校準、端接移動和均衡梁位置一起記錄，查異常能否重複。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Map all tensions within and between groups and check their sum against suspended load. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 纜索群載重分配：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Cable-group load sharing: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「纜索群載重分配」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Cable-group load sharing” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 索力平均值正常仍可能藏有少數高載索，替換索的剛度差亦會重新分配荷載。若只抽測外側容易接近的索，會忽略內部群組的系統性偏差。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A normal mean can conceal a few overloaded ropes, and replacement-rope stiffness changes sharing. Sampling only easily reached outer ropes can miss a systematic imbalance in internal groups. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若只抽測外側容易接近的索，會忽略內部群組的系統性偏差。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Sampling only easily reached outer ropes can miss a systematic imbalance in internal groups.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「總重量除索數就能代表任何一條索的實際最大張力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Total weight divided by rope count gives every ropes actual maximum tension." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 索力平均值正常仍可能藏有少數高載索，替換索的剛度差亦會重新分配荷載。若只抽測外側容易接近的索，會忽略內部群組的系統性偏差。
knowledge.textEn: A normal mean can conceal a few overloaded ropes, and replacement-rope stiffness changes sharing. Sampling only easily reached outer ropes can miss a systematic imbalance in internal groups.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「纜索群載重分配」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Cable-group load sharing" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
均衡梁存在就表示兩端張力必定完全相等。
索力平均值正常仍可能藏有少數高載索，替換索的剛度差亦會重新分配荷載。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
The presence of an equalizer means both end tensions are always equal.
A normal mean can conceal a few overloaded ropes, and replacement-rope stiffness changes sharing.
quiz.explanation: 索力平均值正常仍可能藏有少數高載索，替換索的剛度差亦會重新分配荷載。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A normal mean can conceal a few overloaded ropes, and replacement-rope stiffness changes sharing. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
